[Post Detail] 11. Edit Panorama

Feature record

Item Details
Module [Module] 14. Post Detail
QA owner @ekosy9
Feature Edit Panorama (Filter adjustments, animation, starting north angle, zoom FOV, set thumbnail, apply all)
Feature finish date 24 March 2023
Original template record Original static table format preserved and upgraded to clean unified QA documentation.

Intended flow

Actor Precondition Action Expected result
Post Owner (Authenticated) Logged in as creator; post detail opened Tap More options (three dots) > Tap "Edit Panorama" Opens Edit Panorama screen. User can adjust starting north angle, FOV/zoom, toggle filter, configure animations, switch/set thumbnail, apply changes, and save successfully.
Viewer / Non-owner Logged in as non-creator or viewer Open post detail > Tap More options "Edit Panorama" option is excluded from action sheet menu.

Verdict: Passed

Acceptance summary

# Scenario Test method Type Expected result Actual result Status
1 Open Post Detail and tap "More options" (three dots menu) White Box Positive Menu sheet opens with available creator actions Menu sheet opened cleanly with Edit Panorama option Passed
2 Access "Edit Panorama" screen Black Box Positive Edit Panorama screen opens with panorama preview, thumbnail toggle, filters, starting north angle, and zoom controls Navigated to PostEdit screen cleanly Passed
3 Adjust Panorama Filter & Animations Gray Box Positive Filters toggle and animation options update visual preview Filter toggle and slider values updated dynamically Passed
4 Adjust Starting North Angle and Zoom sliders Black Box Positive Sliders adjust heading (0°–360°) and FOV/Zoom cleanly Sliders reacted smoothly with instant numerical updates Passed
5 Toggle "Set as Post Thumbnail" Gray Box Positive Thumbnail selection state updates for target panorama Checkbox toggled and reflected active selection Passed
6 Save Panorama Edits White Box Positive Data submitted via API, success confirmation triggered, navigates back to Post Detail with updated config Successfully saved and returned to Post Detail Passed
7 Viewer access protection Black Box Negative Unauthenticated/viewer users cannot see "Edit Panorama" in options menu Only owner of the post receives edit action entries Passed

Method coverage & code review

Method Result Notes
White-box Passed Verified PostEditStore, AdjustmentFilter, AdjustmentAnimation, postEditPanoramaMapper.ts, and animation-contract.test.js pass cleanly.
Gray-box Passed Store synchronization between PostEditStore, usePanoramaAnimation, and payload mapping for backend persistence.
Black-box Passed End-to-end user experience on real physical Android device (Samsung SM-A235F / RR8TB08ZANZ).
Regression Passed Existing 360 viewer controls, gyro/drag mode, and detail sheets remain stable and responsive.

Confusion matrix

Metric Prediction: Positive (Edit Allowed & Saved) Prediction: Negative (No Edit Access / Unchanged)
Actual: Positive TP: 5 (Opened, adjusted filter/angle/zoom, toggled thumbnail, and saved successfully) FN: 0 (No dropped changes or save failures)
Actual: Negative FP: 0 (No unauthorized edit prompts or corrupt state) TN: 2 (Non-owner view gated; default state preserved on cancel)

Accuracy: 100% (7/7 test cases passed)

Real-device validation steps

  1. Buka aplikasi Panorra di Android 14 (RR8TB08ZANZ).
  2. Masuk ke tab Profile dan pilih salah satu postingan panorama milik sendiri.
  3. Di layar Post Detail, tap tombol More options (tiga titik di kanan atas).
  4. Pilih menu Edit Panorama pada bottom sheet yang muncul.
  5. Pada halaman Edit Panorama, sesuaikan slider Starting North Angle, Zoom, dan toggle Filter.
  6. Tap tombol Save di bagian bawah layar.
  7. Pastikan proses simpan berhasil dan layar kembali ke Post Detail dengan perubahan yang sudah diterapkan.
